versions.content: Subscription to a SOME/IP Event group A ConsumedSer- viceInstance subscribes to a published event group via a ConsumedEventGroup that is aggregated in the role consumedEventGroup . The eventGroupIdenti- fier identifies the SOME/IP Event Group in the context of the ConsumedService- Instance to which the consumer subscribes.
